required_disposition: Keep unresolved until an explicit PMU startup or independently justified bypass/isolation strategy is selected and proved. Verify private regulator-control GPIO access, reset, wake and power-off paths. Do not apply blanket unused flags or arbitrary bias changes.
evidence: K230 PINOUT main pin sheet r33; default-state sheet r72; TRM PDF p1169 section14.3 and PMU_NORMAL_TIMER_VAL p1180; K230 guide PMU
